title: 2048 Classic
description: Slide numbered tiles on a 4x4 grid and merge matching numbers to reach the legendary 2048 tile.
controls: Arrow keys or W/A/S/D to slide tiles. Swipe supported on touch devices.

title: Neon Snake
description: Guide the glowing neon snake, swallow food orbs, and grow without colliding with walls or your own tail.
controls: Arrow keys or WASD to turn. Space to pause.

title: Block Drop (Tetromino)
description: Rotate and drop falling tetromino blocks to clear complete rows and rack up massive combos.
controls: Arrow Left/Right to move, Up to rotate, Down to soft drop, Space to hard drop.

title: Space Invaders Defender
description: Defend Earth against waves of descending alien warships. Dodge plasma bombs and take down the mothership.
controls: Arrow keys or A/D to steer ship. Spacebar to fire lasers.

title: Neon Breakout
description: Smash your way through vibrant brick formations with energetic ball physics and high-speed paddle action.
controls: Mouse or Arrow Keys to glide the paddle. Space to launch ball.

title: Retro Pong Duel
description: The timeless 1972 arcade duel against an intelligent CPU paddle. First to score 7 wins the tournament.
controls: W/S or Up/Down arrows to steer paddle. Mouse hover also supported.

title: Minesweeper Deluxe
description: Clear the grid without detonating hidden mines. Deduce safe tiles using numbers and place tactical hazard flags.
controls: Left click to reveal cell. Right click or Flag Mode button to plant warning flags.

title: Dino Desert Runner
description: Sprint through prehistoric badlands, leap over desert cacti, and duck below flying pterodactyls.
controls: Spacebar or Up Arrow to jump. Down Arrow to crouch. Tap on mobile.

title: Asteroids 360
description: Pilot your vector spacecraft through treacherous asteroid fields. Blast tumbling meteors before they collide with your hull.
controls: Arrow Left/Right to rotate, Up Arrow / W for thrusters, Space to blast.

title: Four in a Row
description: Drop colored tokens into a 7x6 suspended grid. Connect 4 matching tokens horizontally, vertically, or diagonally.
controls: Click columns 1-7 or tap the target slot to drop chips.

title: Neon Tic-Tac-Toe
description: Fast-paced neon grid duel against an unbeatable AI or play 2-Player local mode with friends.
controls: Click or tap any open square to place your symbol.

title: Maze Muncher
description: Navigate treacherous labyrinth corridors, gobble glowing pellets, and evade the wandering phantom ghosts.
controls: Arrow keys or W/A/S/D to steer direction through maze corners.
